summary: REQ-21 appears implemented by updating the footer brand/about copy to explicitly include “Ontario” while keeping the “Contact Us” section phone-only. The diff also introduces additional footer elements (social links and an external caffeine.ai attribution) that were not requested in the BuildRequest.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/introduced social media “Connect” section with Facebook/X/Instagram icons/links in the footer.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asked to update service-area copy to include “Ontario” and preserve phone-only contact in the Contact Us section; it did not request adding social links.

hallucinated_features.description: Added external “Built with … using caffeine.ai” attribution link with UTM parameters in the footer.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not request any vendor attribution, external referral links, or UTM tracking in the footer; this is additional functionality/content beyond REQ-21.
